headerDisplay: Exposes your Control4 system to Apple Home. Enter your Control4 account email and password; the plugin uses them only to fetch a short-lived token and then talks to your controller locally over your LAN.
footerDisplay: Your credentials are stored only in this Homebridge instance and are sent only to Control4's own servers.

controllerIp.title: Controller IP Address
controllerIp.description: The controller's LAN IP. Leave blank to discover it from your account.

controllerCommonName.title: Controller Common Name
controllerCommonName.description: Only needed if your account has more than one controller, e.g. Living-EA1-000FFF1AFCA9.

pollSeconds.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: Fallback refresh rate. Live updates arrive over the controller's event stream; this just backstops it.

excludeRooms.title: Exclude Rooms
excludeRooms.description: Rooms whose devices should not be exposed to HomeKit.

rediscoverMinutes.title: Re-discover Interval (minutes)
rediscoverMinutes.description: How often to re-read the project so devices added/removed/renamed in Control4 sync to HomeKit without a restart.

exposeTvs.title: Expose Rooms as TVs
exposeTvs.description: Expose each room that has a TV as a HomeKit Television (power/input/volume).

exposeCameras.title: Expose Cameras
exposeCameras.description: Expose Control4 cameras as HomeKit cameras.

secureVideo.title: HomeKit Secure Video
secureVideo.description: Motion-triggered recording on the cameras (requires iCloud+ with HomeKit Secure Video and a home hub).

volumeSliders.title: Volume Slider Tiles
volumeSliders.description: Add a HomeKit volume-slider tile per room with a TV.

exposeScenes.title: Expose Lighting Scenes
exposeScenes.description: Expose Control4 Advanced Lighting scenes as HomeKit switches.

dimRampMs.title: Dimming Ramp (ms)
dimRampMs.description: Fade time for dimmable lights, for smooth dimming. 0 = instant.
